main_measure.name: slope of 5-bar excess return on the high_prox forecast (pooled OLS)
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 confirms (with top-minus-bottom third > 0); t <= -2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return, top third of forecasts minus bottom third

reading: The slope's t uses a day-clustered standard error (cases summed per calendar day, with a G/(G-1) correction), the coin's mean 5-bar return is the mean of its grid returns over all windows, and the thirds are the n//3 lowest and highest cases by post_pipeline_value (stable sort).
decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and 2.
